newsitem.title: UK: BTR at fresh year low, further drop seen.
newsitem.headline: BTR at fresh year low, further drop seen.

text.p: Shares in diversified conglomerate BTR Plc posted a new year's low on Monday and were likely to weaken further, traders said.
By 1330 GMT BTR hit a low of 185p, trading afterwards in a range between 185 and 188p in a volume of 7.7 million shares.
"The stock is only going one way at the moment," said one trader. "It will continue to fall".
The shares have slid since a profit warning in May. The company warned the strength of sterling and weak conditions in key markets would dent sales and operating profits.
